race.description: Leading Edge Security Trotters Discretionary Hcp
race.comment: LEAF STRIDE NZ (8) drew wide when behind the mobile last start but came from the 20m mark to win a standing start race at this circuit and distance prior so the return to those conditions should suit. Good enough to take out a race like this. SECOND TO NUN (1) did a great job to overcome a 50m handicap and win last start, continuing her good form. Player from the front mark. INSTANT DELIGHT NZ (2) only beat one home last time but this is easier and she had looked close to a win when placed in her previous three outings, two of them from standing starts. Deserves another chance. PIZZA PRINCE (4) resumes after 11 weeks having shown some good form last time in. Has trialled and is proven fresh so can open this campaign with a positive effort.
